meta.description:
My first mod! It adds in a lot of new vanilla branches, but I'll leave you to finding out what those are.
It also adds a new planet, because that's also new content, right?
[green]Thanks to my spriter Aegires for making some of theese awesome sprites!

[red]This mod is very ambitious. And unfinished. New Content.

[gold]As of Version 7x1x, the mod's custom and new music has been moved to Chaoticans-mindustry-modding-team/New-Content-Music.
